Kindred Intelligence.

does it allow you to search for any vamp to move or is it just like
Effective Management (move the top vamp)?

We assume it's move the top vamp, but I felt the need to ask because the
rulings on the WW website make no mention of the card.

thanks

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Thu, 18 May 2000, r. brian smith wrote:
> does it allow you to search for any vamp to move or is it just like
> Effective Management (move the top vamp)?

Just the top vamp.

The only ways I can think of to access vampires at any other point in the
deck are Illusions of the Kindred and Recruitment.
